sources.title: DeepSeek-R1 Release (2025/01/20)
sources.evidence: Dated original release announcement identifies model=deepseek-reasoner as the API identifier for DeepSeek-R1, with website/API live at launch. The trailing-slash URL exposes the historical announcement.

sources.title: DeepSeek API Change Log
sources.evidence: Dates the new reasoner model to January 20, 2025; explicitly adds function calling with R1-0528 on May 28, 2025. Records later backing upgrades including V3.2 on December 1 and V4-Flash thinking mode on April 24, 2026. September V4.1 compatibility aliases are different identifiers.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Preview Release
sources.evidence: Explicitly maps deepseek-reasoner to V4-Flash thinking mode, gives Flash 284B total and 13B active parameters and 1M context, and announces legacy alias inaccessibility after July 24, 2026 at 15:59 UTC.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash model card
sources.evidence: Describes the preview Flash text language model and released weights: 284B total, 13B activated, million-token context and MIT license. Distinguishes model counts from the separate 291B Hugging Face storage badge.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
sources.evidence: Sections 2 and 4.2.1 specify Transformer structure, DeepSeekMoE feed-forward layers, hybrid compressed attention, and exact Flash nominal counts of 284B total and 13B activated per token. Section 5 describes thinking modes and a tool-call schema for the V4 models.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash LICENSE
sources.evidence: The official backing-weight repository publishes the MIT License.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.2 Release
sources.evidence: Documents thinking integrated into tool use and support for tools in both modes of V3.2, a documented earlier backing model of this alias.

sources.title: DeepSeek Models & Pricing
sources.evidence: Current pricing lists deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro, with compatibility routes for deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp. It does not list deepseek-reasoner or establish its current operation.

sources.title: Models.dev deepseek-reasoner record
sources.evidence: Baseline lead combines a December 1, 2025 release date and V3.2 weight link with 1M context. These are different points in the alias history and require primary-source reconciliation.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.2 model card
sources.evidence: The baseline weight link describes V3.2 and its thinking-with-tools capability; it is an earlier backing model, superseded by the explicit April 2026 mapping.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash configuration
sources.evidence: Defines DeepseekV4ForCausalLM with 43 layers, routed/shared experts and token vocabulary. The checkpoint configuration has 1048576 positional embeddings; this is separate from the documented 1000000-token API context.

name.note: Readable normalization of the official deepseek-reasoner identifier; this is a mutable API alias.

developer.note: Developer identified by its official API announcements.

family.note: Descriptive catalog grouping for the DeepSeek thinking alias across generations; not a fixed checkpoint family.

release_date.note: Initial public release of this API identifier with R1. The baseline December 1, 2025 date is a V3.2 upgrade.

open_weights.note: The last explicitly mapped V4-Flash preview has released weights; no distinct checkpoint exists for the alias itself.

license.note: License of the documented backing weights; hosted-service terms are separate.

parameters_b.note: Developer nominal total parameters, in billions, of the documented V4-Flash preview backing model.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer nominal parameters activated per token, in billions, for that same preview.

architecture.note: Transformer with MoE feed-forward layers, compressed sparse/heavily compressed attention and manifold-constrained hyper-connections.

context_window.note: Documented API context for the April 2026 mapping, rather than the checkpoint positional-embedding limit.

modalities.note: Text language-model backing weights and text message/tool-call schema. Later vision aliases do not establish vision support for this identifier.

reasoning.note: Initially the R1 reasoning model; the final explicit mapping selects V4-Flash thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Historically documented for this alias with R1-0528; later V3.2 thinking-with-tools and the mapped V4 preview tool-call schema confirm support. Not an endpoint availability claim.

description.value: Legacy DeepSeek reasoning API alias, first released with R1 and last explicitly mapped to DeepSeek-V4-Flash preview in thinking mode; announced for retirement in July 2026.
description.note: Replaces generic capability wording with exact alias identity and documented lifecycle.

patch.description: Legacy DeepSeek reasoning API alias, first released with R1 and last explicitly mapped to DeepSeek-V4-Flash preview in thinking mode; announced for retirement in July 2026.
patch.notes: Specifications describe the last explicit April 24, 2026 V4-Flash preview mapping. The January 20, 2025 release date is the alias debut with R1, not the backing preview release. DeepSeek announced inaccessibility after July 24, 2026, 15:59 UTC; no authenticated endpoint test was performed. Later V4.1 compatibility mappings name other identifiers. Counts are developer nominal model parameters, not storage totals; MIT/open weights refer to the backing checkpoint.

V4 preview mapping and retirement announcement
Last documented backing weights: V4-Flash preview

summary: All 14 fields reviewed. Correct alias debut to January 20, 2025. Add primary-supported 284B total, 13B active, MoE architecture and MIT license for its last explicit V4-Flash preview mapping. Retain documented text, 1M context, reasoning and tool support with lifecycle qualifications. Announced retirement is recorded; current endpoint operation was not tested, and no V4.1 specifications are transferred to this identifier.
